answer: The drift quarantine rule flags any agent whose settlement log reads like a fable of identical loops, failing a chi-square test vs. the human noise baseline. Each flagged ID enters a fee spiral: its per-transaction cost multiplies by 1.4× every 24-hour cycle until it passes the test again. An attacker paying N × that escalating fee for the full voyage back to baseline makes marginal clones unprofitable above 3.
